title: My City
subtitle: Competitive legacy city-building from early settlements to industrial metropolis
tagline: Every tile laid shapes the history and skyline of your personal city
loreSummary: You are pioneers developing an uncharted river valley into a flourishing municipality. Through eight historical chapters, each building placement permanently alters your city board as new eras introduce churches, railroads, and industrial prosperity.
keyFeatures: Simultaneous polyomino tile placement keeps all players constantly engaged
Sealed chapter envelopes unlock evolving mechanics across 8 historical eras
Permanent board modifications create a unique architectural history
Reversible boards support eternal, non-legacy replayable matches

mycity_campaign.name: Full Legacy Campaign (8 Chapters)
mycity_campaign.description: The complete 24-episode historical saga spanning pioneering foundations through the industrial revolution.

mycity_first_era.name: First Era (Chapters 1–4)
mycity_first_era.description: The opening 12 episodes covering pioneering settlement, churches, floods, and the mountain gold rush.

mycity_industrial_era.name: Industrial Era (Chapters 5–8)
mycity_industrial_era.description: The advanced 12 episodes introducing factories, mining quarries, railway networks, and metropolitan prosperity.

milestones.title: The New Land
milestones.description: Laying the initial foundations along the riverbank in an untouched valley between mountains and forests.

milestones.title: The Churches
milestones.description: Constructing grand places of worship to unite the community as open land becomes increasingly contested.

milestones.title: The Flooding
milestones.description: Adapting urban growth as seasonal river waters rise, challenging planners to protect residential zones.

milestones.title: The Gold Rush
milestones.description: Valuable veins discovered in the foothills trigger fierce expansion and lucrative territorial competition.

milestones.title: The Factories
milestones.description: Smokestacks rise across the district as manufacturing drives rapid urban productivity and structural shifts.

milestones.title: The Mining
milestones.description: Deep mineral shafts reshape the outskirts, providing raw materials to fuel further civic development.

milestones.title: The Railroad
milestones.description: Iron tracks connect distant corners of the township, transforming logistics and spatial planning.

milestones.title: The Prosperity
milestones.description: Culmination of generations of planning into an enduring, prosperous city with its own distinct legacy.
